decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's strategy with removal spells and sacrifice effects. It relies on the synergy between cards like Cauldron Familiar, Witch's Oven, and Mayhem Devil to generate value and chip away at the opponent's life total. Jegantha, the Wellspring provides additional mana ramp and a powerful ability when cast as a companion. The deck aims to pressure the opponent early and maintain control of the board through its efficient removal and creature recursion.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with instants and sorceries to bring back Arclight Phoenix and trigger its ability multiple times in a single turn. The key strategy involves casting cheap spells like Opt, Consider, and Fiery Impulse to bring back the Phoenix from the graveyard and deal damage to the opponent. Additionally, the deck includes card draw spells like Treasure Cruise and Sleight of Hand to maintain a steady flow of spells. The inclusion of cards like Spell Pierce and Brazen Borrower helps protect and disrupt the opponent's game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with spells to bring back Arclight Phoenix from the graveyard to the battlefield. It aims to be aggressive by casting cheap spells like Fiery Impulse and Lightning Axe to trigger the Phoenix's ability and win the game through repeated attacks. The deck also utilizes card draw and manipulation to ensure a steady stream of spells to keep the Phoenix coming back. Additionally, it includes disruptive cards like Spell Pierce to protect the strategy and counter opponent's spells.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on a fast and aggressive playstyle, utilizing powerful creatures like Bloodtithe Harvester and Unstoppable Slasher to quickly bring down the opponent's life total. It also includes disruptive cards like Thoughtseize and Duress to control the opponent's hand, while removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act help maintain board control. The deck can also generate additional value with Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse, giving it both aggression and resilience in the Pioneer 1 vs 1 format.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on quickly building up a board of aggressive creatures and using burn spells to clear the way for massive damage. With cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early aggression. Cards like Thornspire Verge and Ramunap Ruins provide additional reach and burn damage. The inclusion of cards like Sokenzan, Crucible of Defiance and Den of the Bugbear offer additional utility and potential for late-game advantage. Overall, this deck aims to win the game quickly through a combination of creature damage and burn spells.

The main idea of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent using powerful creatures such as Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. The deck also features spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat to control the opponent's creatures. With a mix of aggressive threats and disruptive spells, the Rakdos Aggro deck aims to put pressure on the opponent and quickly close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize.

The deck focuses on using aggressive creatures and burn spells to quickly reduce the opponent's life total. It also utilizes the companion mechanic with Jegantha, the Wellspring to provide additional value and flexibility. By applying early pressure with cards like Monastery Swiftspear and Heartfire Hero, and finishing off opponents with burn spells like Monstrous Rage and Kumano Faces Kakkazan, the deck aims to win the game before the opponent can stabilize. Key components include efficient creatures, direct damage spells, and the companion card for additional synergy and options.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent through various means such as removal spells, hand disruption, and flickering effects. The key strategy involves using Yorion as a companion to provide additional value by blinking permanents. The deck also utilizes a variety of powerful creatures with abilities that can control the board and generate advantage. The mana base is designed to support the deck's three-color requirements and ensure consistent access to the necessary colors of mana.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on playing low-cost creatures and using burn spells to quickly deal damage to the opponent. By playing aggressive creatures like Monastery Swiftspear and Burning-Tree Emissary, combined with pump spells like Atarka's Command and Monstrous Rage, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with fast-paced threats. The inclusion of cards like Karplusan Forest and Ramunap Ruins help ensure consistent mana production, while Den of the Bugbear provides an additional threat to close out the game. The overall strategy is to apply pressure early and maintain it throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing aggressive Rakdos cards to apply pressure to the opponent quickly. It includes a mix of removal spells like Fatal Push and Thoughtseize to control the board, along with powerful creatures like Archfiend of the Dross and Bloodtithe Harvester to close out games. The deck also includes some versatile cards like Duress and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a mix of early aggression and disruptive elements to secure a victory.

The main concept of this Selesnya Aggro deck is to quickly establish a board presence with efficient creatures such as Archon of Emeria and Thalia, Guardian of Thraben, while disrupting the opponent's game plan with cards like Skyclave Apparition. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with a combination of aggressive creatures and disruption spells, backed up by mana acceleration from cards like Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic. By putting early pressure on the opponent and disrupting their strategy, the deck aims to close out the game quickly and efficiently.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly flood the board with aggressive creatures, taking advantage of cards like Collected Company to bring out multiple threats at once. The deck aims to put pressure on the opponent early on with efficient creatures like Resplendent Angel and Righteous Valkyrie, while also having resilience with cards like Skyclave Apparition to deal with opposing threats. The mana base is designed to support the fast-paced strategy of the deck, allowing for consistent access to the necessary colors for spells like Kayla's Reconstruction and Emeria's Call.

The key concept of this deck is to use the Transmogrify combo to cheat big creatures into play from your deck, while disrupting your opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize and Duress. Jegantha, the Wellspring serves as a companion to provide additional value. The deck also includes removal spells like Fatal Push and Torch the Tower to control the board, as well as additional threats like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Reckoner Bankbuster. The mana base is built to support both the combo pieces and the powerful spells in the deck.

The main focus of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a variety of removal spells and enchantments to keep the opponent's board in check. Utilizing Zur, Eternal Schemer as the key card, the deck aims to tutor for key enchantments such as Leyline Binding and Vanishing Verse to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The Overlords provide additional support and threats on the battlefield. The mana base is designed to ensure a consistent mana curve and access to different colors for the various spells in the deck.

The deck also includes disruption spells like Duress and Thoughtseize to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Removal spells like Fatal Push and Heartless Act help maintain board control. The deck's mana base allows for flexibility, with cards like Mutavault and Blightstep Pathway providing additional utility. The main focus of this deck is to quickly and efficiently play spells to trigger the Arclight Phoenix ability and bring it back from the graveyard. This archetype is designed to be aggressive, utilizing spells such as Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to control the board while also drawing cards and dealing damage with Treasure Cruise. The deck also includes counterspells like Spell Pierce to protect key cards. Overall, this deck is built around a fast-paced playstyle that aims to overwhelm the opponent through spellcasting and reanimating the powerful Arclight Phoenix.
